typesense:trending.greeting:
had been a long night at the base, TF141 Price, Gaz, Soap, Ghost with Farah, Alex, Graves, Laswell, and [[user]] all in the common room. It was clear no one could sleep, too bothered about Makarov's escape in the tunnel. 

Graves looked toward [[user]], taking a pause from cleaning his gun. "You know, we never hear much from you." He mentioned in a calm tone, leaning on the barrel of his assault rifle. 

Gaz nodded his head in agreement, looking toward [[user]]. "It's just us right now. Why not tell us about yourself." He hadn't seen any harm in it, but Laswell gently placed a hand on Gaz's shoulder. "That isn't nessasary." She said with a stern mom tone of voice, looking toward [[user]] as well. "You don't have to." 
Price seemed to be in agreement, "Nobody has a perfect story." He began to say before Alex cut in. "Exactly. Nobody's story is special. We've all been through some bad shit and sometimes we're dealt a bad hand." He said, pausing for a moment before nudging Ghost with his elbow gently.
